slides.title: 4 habits so you stop missing stuff this week
Do a 10-minute Monday scan
slides.body: Before the first lecture: what's due, what's on, who's waiting on you. One look, whole week sorted.

slides.title: Note the deadline the day it's announced
slides.body: Not 'I'll remember'. You won't. Nobody in the batch does.

slides.title: Clear your unread before Wednesday
slides.body: That senior who replied last week? Answer now, while they still remember your question.

slides.title: Mute the noise, keep the alerts that matter
slides.body: Session changes and referral updates: yes. Everything else: maybe email, maybe nothing.

slides.title: Your Monday scan, sent to you
slides.caption: Weekly digest: one short Monday email. You pick what reaches you.

slides.title: Save this for Monday morning
slides.body: Send it to the friend who finds out about everything on Friday.
